title: PNG text chunk carla:illumination, format version 1
description: What the run declared the sun to be for this frame -- the scenario's epoch, the illumination policy, the frame's civil instant and the sun declared for it -- and how far the world's sun was from it. Written only in a run that declares its illumination. This schema describes format version 1; a chunk with no format_version was written before chunks carried one and is version 1.

format_version.description: The chunk's format version. Absent from a chunk written before chunks carried one, which is version 1.

policy.description: The illumination policy the run followed.

epoch_honoured.description: Whether the frame was lit by the sun of its own declared civil instant.

audited.description: Whether the world's sun was compared against the declaration on this frame's tick.

rate.description: Sun-clock seconds per simulated second, under the advance policy only.

freeze_at_civil_time.description: The civil time of day the sun is held at, under the freeze_at policy only.

epoch_digest.description: SHA-256 of the scenario's epoch, so a frame separated from its run still names it.

epoch_civil.description: The civil instant simulated second zero stands for, with its UTC offset.

utc_offset_hours.description: The epoch's declared UTC offset, hours.

declared_civil.description: This frame's simulated instant as a civil time, with its UTC offset.

declared_utc.description: The same instant in UTC: the key to join this frame to anything outside the pipeline.

sun_declared.description: The date and clock the sun was declared to hold for this frame, with its UTC offset: the frame's civil instant under a policy that honors the epoch, the window's opening instant under a freeze.

sun_elevation_declared_deg.description: The geometric elevation of the declared sun.

sun_corrected_elevation_declared_deg.description: The refraction-corrected elevation of the declared sun.

declared_elevation.description: Which of the two elevations a declared window elevation means.

residual_clock_s.description: The world's sun clock minus the declared one.

residual_deg.description: The angle between the world's sun and the declared sun.

residual_corrected_deg.description: The world's refraction-corrected elevation minus the declared one, where the world reports it.
